dedupe.result: All five additions are new to the completed ledger. The PRL pair-plasma article is a newly accepted version of a 2025 author preprint and is distinct from strong-field electron-ion transparency records. The PRX Intelligence closure appeared only as an unsuccessful April blocked-day candidate, never entered the ledger, and is now ingested for the first time using the lawful corresponding author preprint. The AWAKE source experiment, linear-Breit-Wheeler reorientation study and laser-channel magnetic-island study are distinct in apparatus, reaction channel and observable from prior wakefield, nonlinear-Breit-Wheeler and DLA records.
